context_requirements: Expression of SRD5A1 and/or SRD5A2 to convert testosterone to DHT
Functional androgen receptor (AR) signaling for the canonical downstream effect
Prostate lineage or AR-positive context for meaningful transcriptional response
Sufficient endogenous androgen substrate; in standard culture media androgen levels are low
falsifiers: No change in AR target genes (e.g., KLK3/PSA, TMPRSS2) in AR-positive lines such as VCAP or LNCaP
No reduction in proliferation or cell-cycle gene expression in any line at 24 h
No induction of apoptosis or stress-response genes in prostate lines at 24 h
Strong transcriptional responses in AR-negative, SRD5A-low lines (e.g., A375, A549, HA1E) comparable to prostate lines

evidence.supports: Finasteride causes prostate atrophy and apoptosis in vivo, indicating 5ARI can reduce prostate cell survival
Dutasteride reduces viability/proliferation and alters cell cycle, metabolic, and apoptotic gene expression in LNCaP prostate cancer cells
Dutasteride induces dose-dependent apoptosis in androgen-sensitive prostate cell lines but not in androgen-independent PC-3
Dutasteride alters gene expression in prostate cancer xenografts, consistent with AR-pathway suppression
5ARI treatment lowers DHT and AR target gene expression (PSA, TMPRSS2) in human prostate tissue
